== 描述 ==
要使用此模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom 的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Item
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | type          = 
 | effects       = 
 | source        = 
 | buy           = 
 | sell          = 
}}
</pre>

== 示例输出 ==
{{Item
 | title         = 能量花
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | type          = 食物
 | effects       = +1 火焰
 | source        = 商贩
 | buy           = 5g
 | sell          = 1g
}}<pre>
{{Item
 | title         = 能量花
 | image         = Example.jpg

}}
